establishment.name: Happy Hearts Center at McNair Farms

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK COMPLETELY BLOCKED BY BOXES, GARDEN TOOLS, AND OTHER MISCELLANEOUS ITEMS AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED ALL ITEMS FROM THE SINK BASIN/IN FRONT OF THE SINK DURING THE INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS THE HANDWASHING SINK MUST ALWAYS BE ACCESSIBLE. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF HANDWASHING SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED AT THE HAND SINK. PLEASE ENSURE IT IS POSTED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of CLEANING materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED TWO SPRAY BOTTLES WITHOUT LABELS AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC ADDED LABELS TO SPRAY BOTTLES DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL CLEANING SOLUTIONS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY LABELED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: WHIRLPOOL COOLER IS NOT NSF-APPROVED OR EQUIVALENT.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. PIC UNDERSTANDS WHEN THIS COOLER BREAKS OR NEEDS TO BE REPAIRED IN THE FUTURE, IT SHALL BE REPLACED WITH A N NSF-APPROVED COMMERCIAL-GRADE COOLER.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK IN KITCHEN MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 77F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINK MUST MEET 100F BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 77F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PLEASE ENSURE THREE-VAT SINK CAN MEET 110F BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.
